presentationPatterns.rule: Preserve the captured source reference exactly.

presentationPatterns.regex: ^(.+); passende bezahlte Maschine/Werkzeuge, lokaler Input und freie Ausgänge(; Gesteins-Packvolumen und Quellfreigabe offen)?$
presentationPatterns.template: {quantities}; suitable paid machine/tools, local input and clear outputs
presentationPatterns.optionalSuffix: ; rock pack volume and source admission remain unresolved
presentationPatterns.rule: Translate only when the complete requirement matches. Split the captured quantities on the exact delimiter ' + ' and require every term to match the quantityTerm pattern. Append optionalSuffix only when the source suffix is present.

Preserve the quantity value and its source unit; change decimal commas to dots and map Stück to items. Translate the captured item name using exact known catalog-name mappings before composing the text. Do not translate IDs, infer availability or convert material quantities.
Use the same quantity, unit and exact catalog-name presentation rules as quantityTerm. Keep the original published deficit and inventory unchanged.

fallbackRule: For unmatched text, retain the original source string. Apply these mappings only to presentation; leave IDs, source references, commands, checkpoints, status values and user labels unchanged.
